[OC]|cffffffffLevel check|r  -  this chapter wants level 41. The highest required level of its quests is 38, but the mobs are the limit: Cinderscale Warriors 41-42, the Eastsea pirates' Bombardiers 43-44 and Raiders 44-45, and Admiral Lamora 45. Under 41: do Gelinda's whelps, Sleebo, the murlocs and Trapclaw first and leave Unchecked Expansion (95122) and Admiral Lamora (95124) for last; if Lamora is still too much, abandon 95124 rather than wait

[OC]|cffffffffPowderfuse Port|r  -  the neutral goblin port on the east coast of the Riverglades. You start in Farholde Keep after chapter 40, hearth = Farholde Keep and it stays there: the port has no flight path, and every leg here is within ~35 units of it. About 37,950 quest XP on the plain quests and 2g 25s of quest money. Givers and hand-ins come from the DB; the points marked "Wowhead's map" have no position in it
